title: Duality of analytic Hopf algebras and the Amice transform
summary: We construct global versions of the analytic Hopf algebras used in the $p$-adic Fourier theory of Amice and Mahler over a general Banach ring, independently of the choice of prime $p$. This is done by generalising Köthe echelon and coechelon spaces to an arbitrary base Banach ring $R$ and proving reflexivity and nuclearity results. We show how to define an analytic Hopf algebra structure on them and investigate their duality theory.
